limitations: packetDelayMs comes from trace metadata as the transport simulator delay; measuredResponseMilliseconds is a separate observed duration.
Tick clocks are kept in separate source, owner-local, and server domains; values are never subtracted across domains.
Quaternion values are compared sign-invariantly because raw transmitted Euler components were not captured; a match is reconstructed state evidence, not wire-component proof.
State handoff matching requires matching object/owner identity and quaternion-sync mode. Local-space matches are left unverified because parent transform context is not recorded.
Owner pushes may be matched through validation, including pushes observed after request submission; last pre-request push remains a separate sample.
A receive with no owner push in the recorded trace window is marked as unobserved owner history, not proof that no earlier push existed.
A matching observer hook is evidence of matching observed state, not proof of a physical transport send or NGO queue delivery.
Owner and server spawn generations are peer-local and are reported/validated per replica, never compared across peers.
Missing data and ambiguous state matches remain explicitly unresolved.
Embedded metadata/snapshots are not additional trials.
